body: System SYS-SR-10 owns the project composition allocation: parent owns immediate-child graph, nested parents own further decomposition, shared relationships belong to nearest shared parent. System graph now shows three main owners; Skill, CLI and Engineering own internal views. Authoring is a named-section parent and has its Design-child view with Proposal/Plan capabilities clearly distinguished. Replaced centralized detailed graph with owner links; parent tables retain navigation. No new model files, global public diagram mandate, runtime or product behavioral changes. Prior exact model identities captured before edits; original composition adoption retained and earlier review remains historical until reassessed.

decisions.rationale: Preserve the three product/realization owners while resolving repeated equivalent execution and the remaining serial case population under the approved proposal.
Correct Design Review finding parallel-maintenance-allocation-scope without expanding historical exceptions implicitly.
User explicitly requires every parent model to own its subsystem system-design graph. Apply recursively to this repository composition without redefining published skill behavior.
